facts.fact: KRAY 在 Camp ██████ 与 Tom 会面，营地在某地以西数英里。
facts.anchor: KRAY met Tom at Camp ██████ , several miles west of someplace else.

facts.fact: Tom 来自马萨诸塞州 Natick，呼号“Critter”；Geoff 来自俄勒冈州 Tillamook，呼号“Skid”，两人都是前海豹队员。
facts.anchor: Tom, who hailed from Natick, Massachusetts, was “Critter.” Geoff, from Tillamook, Oregon, was “Skid.”

facts.fact: 他们乘坐的黑色原厂装甲德系 SUV 车窗玻璃三英寸厚，后门纵向分为上下两段。
facts.anchor: a black, factory-armored German baby with three-inch thick window glass and a two-part rear door, split vertically

facts.fact: KRAY 做出“Condition 1 Carry”：枪膛里已有一发，弹匣里还有十五发。
facts.anchor: and there’s fifteen more right behind it

facts.fact: TDY 开始数周后发生第一起事件：他们与一名 █████ 特工一起在城里开车，KRAY 与该特工同坐后座。
facts.anchor: The first happened several weeks into KRAY’s TDY, when they were tooling around town with an █████ agent sitting in the back seat next to KRAY.

facts.fact: 两辆 Humvee 前后截停他们，KRAY 数到八支 M16 对准他们的脸。
facts.anchor: He counted eight M16s leveled at their faces.

facts.fact: 返程走 Route Irish 时，他们离基地还有两英里，又有三发子弹击中车辆左侧，三十秒后脱离射程。
facts.anchor: Meanwhile, three more incoming rounds impacted the left side of the vehicle

facts.fact: 第二起事件中，黑暗中滚来的“手榴弹”其实是一罐可乐，Tom 身下只剩一罐压扁的 Coke，可乐四处喷溅。
facts.anchor: Beneath him lay one very flat can of Coke, the contents of which had sprayed out in every direction.
